title: How Rho calculates carbon offsets
summary: This document explains how Rho calculates carbon offsets: for each eligible purchase, it multiplies the posted dollar amount by $1.25 to determine grams of CO₂ offset, and refunds reduce accrued offsets at the same $1.25 rate. Only eligible purchase transactions accrue offsets; EveryonePay transfers do not accrue offsets (even if $3,000). Offsets are aggregated over the statement period and rounded to whole grams for environmental reporting, and the $1.25 calculation rate is shown in impact details.
